```{r}
#| include: false
source("_helpers.R")
sw <- read_data("software.yml")
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
emit(sw$intro)

if (length(sw$tools)) {
  rule()
  eyebrow(sw$tools_heading %||% "Open tools")
  tools_block(sw$tools)
}

if (length(sw$pipelines)) {
  rule()
  eyebrow(sw$pipelines_heading %||% "Internal pipelines")
  tools_block(sw$pipelines)
}

if (length(sw$closing)) {
  rule()
  emit(sw$closing)
}
```
